This private workbench remains outside release distributions. It exercises
current normalization, filtering, permutation and export interfaces on the
local plasma gene-count slice. It does not certify sparse or cell-free RNA
inference, and no clinical or rare-event conclusion is drawn.

The selection uses known patient identity, one sorted library per study and
patient, and available malignant/nonmalignant metadata. Technical zero-depth
libraries are excluded before fitting. Group-confounded studies, tissue mixtures
and protocol effects still limit interpretation even with within-study shuffles.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import json,os,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import wade
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd().parent/"tools"))
from notebook_support import output_dir,export_table,markdown_table,cached_wade,array_hash
OUT=output_dir("rna100k")
config_path=Path(os.environ["WADE_TCGA_CONFIG"])
config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
def path(key):
    p=Path(config[key]).expanduser()
    return p if p.is_absolute() else config_path.parent/p
samples=pl.read_parquet(path("samples"))
scan=pl.scan_ipc(path("counts"))
libraries=scan.collect_schema().names()
eligible=samples.filter((pl.col("specimen_type")=="plasma") & pl.col("is_malignant").is_not_null()
                        & pl.col("library").is_in(libraries))
known=eligible.filter(pl.col("patient_uid").is_not_null() & (pl.col("patient_uid")!=""))
selected=known.sort("study","patient_uid","library").unique(subset=["study","patient_uid"],keep="first",maintain_order=True)
export_table(eligible.filter(~pl.col("library").is_in(selected["library"].to_list())),OUT,"identity-exclusions")
genes=pl.read_excel(path("genes"))
counts=scan.select(selected["library"].to_list()).collect().to_numpy().astype(float)
nonempty=counts.sum(axis=0)>0
export_table(selected.filter(pl.Series(~nonempty)),OUT,"empty-library-exclusions")
selected=selected.filter(pl.Series(nonempty));counts=counts[:,nonempty]
export_table(selected,OUT,"sample-order")
qc=wade.library_qc(counts)
export_table(selected.select("library","study","is_malignant").with_columns(**{k:pl.Series(v) for k,v in qc.items()}),OUT,"library-qc")
cond=selected["is_malignant"].to_numpy().astype(int)
strata=selected["study"].to_numpy()
```

Library-total normalization here is an explicitly limited diagnostic choice;
it assumes comparable composition and is not a sparse normalization endorsement.
The per-sample CPM display does not use other libraries. The inference call
uses raw counts and frozen relative exposures, with a deliberately short 1,999
cap for a scaling exercise. This cap cannot resolve isolated transcriptome-wide
discoveries. Do not interpret its q-values as a validated biological result.

```{python}
#| label: current-api
#| output: false
norm=wade.fit_normalization(counts,method="library",gene_names=genes["gene_name"].to_numpy(),sample_names=selected["library"].to_numpy())
keep=wade.filter_counts(counts,min_count=3,min_samples=2)
start=time.perf_counter()
res=cached_wade(counts,cond,normalization=norm,test_genes=keep,strata=strata,
                gene_names=genes["gene_name"].to_numpy(),sample_names=selected["library"].to_numpy(),max_permutations=1999,seed=1)
wade.write_results(res,OUT/"diagnostic-all-genes.tsv")
_ = (OUT/"timing.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,genes=int(res.tested.sum()),
    samples=len(cond),max_permutations=1999,capped=int(np.sum(res.tested & (res.n_exceedances<20))),
    count_sha256=array_hash(counts),discovery_claim=False),indent=2)+"\n")
```

```{python}
#| label: accounting
#| output: asis
markdown_table(selected.group_by("study","is_malignant").len().sort("study","is_malignant"),OUT,"cohort-accounting")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-private-qc
#| fig-cap: "Depth and complexity of the selected private libraries. This figure is a technical diagnostic and remains local."
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.5),layout="constrained")
for group,color,label in [(0,"#d99143","Nonmalignant"),(1,"#2675ac","Malignant")]:
    mask=cond==group
    ax.scatter(np.log10(qc["depth"][mask]),qc["n_detected"][mask],s=10,alpha=.4,color=color,label=label)
ax.set(xlabel="Gene-count depth, log10",ylabel="Detected genes")
ax.legend()
fig
```
